## API Reference: Payments
- Orders
  - [Order Object](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/order-object.md)
  - [Create Order API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/create-order.md): The following endpoint creates an Order
  - [Order Fetch API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-order.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Orders created
  - [Order Fetch by ID API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-order-by-id.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single Order
- Payments
  - [Payment Object](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-object.md)
  - Payment Charge API
    - [Virtual Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-virtual-account.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for virtual account
    - [E-wallet](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-ewallet.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for E-wallet
    - [QRIS](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-qris.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for QRIS
    - [Card](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-card.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for Card
    - [Retail Store](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-retail-store.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for Retail Store
    - [Online Banking](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-online-banking.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for online banking
    - [Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL)](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-charge-bnpl.md): The following endpoint charges the payment for Buy Now Pay Later
  - [Payment Fetch API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/payment-fetch-api.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Payments created
  - [Payment Fetch by ID](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-payment-by-id.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single payment
  - [Check Payment Status](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/check-payment-status.md): The following endpoint checks the status of a single Payment
  - [Verify Payments](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/verify-payments.md): The following endpoint verifies the signature of payment callback
  - [Cancel Payment API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/cancel-payment-api.md): The following endpoint cancels a single Payment
- Custom Virtual Account APIs
  - [Create Virtual Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/create-virtual-account.md): The following endpoint creates a new virtual account
  - [Fetch Virtual Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-virtual-account.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of all Virtual Accounts created
  - [Fetch Virtual Account by ID](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-virtual-account-by-id.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single Virtual Account
  - [Patch Virtual Accounts By ID](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/virtual-accounts-patch-by-id.md): The following endpoint is used to override Expiry Time of a single Virtual Account.
- SNAP Payments APIs
  - [Generate Access Token (B2B) API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/snap-payment-apis.md): The following endpoint generate access token for SNAP transaction APIs
  - Virtual Account APIs
    - [Create Virtual Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/snap-create-virtual-account.md): The following endpoint creates a new virtual account
    - [Inquiry Virtual Account API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/inquiry-virtual-account-1.md): The following endpoint can be used to inquiry a virtual account information.
    - [Update Virtual Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/update-virtual-account.md): Use this endpoint to update the properties of an existing virtual account. Common use cases include:  - Updating the transaction amount for closed virtual accounts  - Extending or modifying the…
  - eWallet APIs
    - [Create eWallet Payment API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/create-ewallet-payment.md): The following endpoint can be used to initiate payment via eWallets.
    - [Inquiry eWallet Payment Status](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/inquiry-ewallet-status.md): The following endpoint can be used to inquiry an eWallet payment status.
    - [Cancel eWallet Payment](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/cancel-ewallet-payment.md): The following endpoint can be used to cancel an incomplete eWallet payment.
    - [Refund eWallet Payment](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/refund-ewallet-payment.md): The following endpoint can be used to refund a completed eWallet payment.
    - [eWallet Notification](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/ewallet-notif.md): Durianpay triggers events whenever a status change occurs on your SNAP eWallet transaction. These events are sent to your configured webhook URL via HTTP POST.  - If your server does not respond with…
  - QRIS APIs
    - [Generate QRIS](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/generate-qris.md): The following endpoint can be used to generate a QRIS code.
    - [Query QRIS](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/inquiry-qris.md): The following endpoint can be used to query a QRIS payment.
    - [Cancel QRIS](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/cancel-qris.md): The following endpoint can be used to cancel an incomplete QRIS payment.
    - [Refund QRIS Payment](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/refund-ewallet-payment-1.md): The following endpoint can be used to refund a completed QRIS payment.
    - [QRIS Notification](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/qris-notif.md): Durianpay triggers events whenever a status change occurs on your SNAP QRIS transaction. These events are sent to your configured webhook URL via HTTP POST.  - If your server does not respond with…

## API Reference: Pay outs
- SNAP Disbursement APIs
  - [Disbursement Status Definition](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/disbursement.md)
  - [Generate Access Token (B2B) API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/access-token-b2b.md): The following endpoint generate access token for SNAP transaction APIs
  - [Bank Account Inquiry API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/bank-account-inquiry-api.md): The following endpoint can be used to check validity of destination bank account and account name information
  - [Bank Transfer API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/bank-transfer-api.md): The following endpoint to submit bank transfer pay outs
  - [Bank Transfer Status Inquiry API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/bank-transfer-status-inquiry-api.md): The following endpoint to inquiry bank transfer pay outs status
  - [E-Wallet Account Inquiry API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/ewallet-account-inquiry-api.md): The following endpoint can be used to check validity of e-wallet account and account name information
  - [E-Wallet Transfer API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/ewallet-transfer-api.md): The following endpoint to submit e-wallet transfer pay outs
  - [E-Wallet Transfer Status Inquiry API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/ewallet-transfer-status-inquiry-api.md): The following endpoint to inquiry e-wallet transfer pay outs
  - [Balance Inquiry API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/balance-inquiry-api.md): The following endpoint fetch the current balance in the merchant's Durianpay account.
  - [Transfer Bank Notify](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/transfer-bank-notify.md)
  - [Response Code Handling](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/response-code-handling.md)
  - [SNAP Bank Code List](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/snap-bank-code-list.md)

## API Reference: Platform APIs
- Sub-Accounts APIs
  - [Register Sub-Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/register-sub-account.md): The following endpoint registers a sub account under your master account.
  - [Update Sub-Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/update-sub-account-api.md): The following endpoint updates subaccount's informations
  - [Fetch Sub-Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-subaccount.md): This following endpoint retrieves the details of all created subaccounts
  - [Update Sub-Account Fees](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/update-sub-account-fees.md): This following endpoint allows master accounts to manage fees for subaccounts
  - [Fetch Sub-Account Fees](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-sub-account-fees.md): The following endpoint retrieves fees of a single subaccount
  - [Fetch Subaccount Balance API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-subaccount-balance.md): The following endpoint retrieves balance of a single subaccount
- E-Wallet Account Binding APIs
  - [Bind E-Wallet Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/bind-e-wallet-account.md): The following endpoint binds E-wallet Account.
  - [Unbind E-Wallet Account](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/unbind-e-wallet-account.md): The following endpoint unbinds E-wallet Account.
  - [Fetch E-Wallet Account Details](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/fetch-e-wallet-account-details.md): The following endpoint fetch E-wallet Account details.
- Customer APIs
  - [Update Customer API](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/update-customer-api.md)

## API Reference: After Payments
- Refund APIs
  - [Create Refund](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/create-refund.md): The following endpoint creates an Refund.
  - [Refund Fetch](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/refund-fetch.md): The following endpoint retrieves list of all Refunds created
  - [Refund Fetch by ID](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/refund-fetch-by-id.md): The following endpoint retrieves the details of a single refund
  - [Refund Fetch by Payment ID](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/get-refund-by-payment-id.md)

## API Reference: Subscriptions
- Subscriptions APIs
  - [Create Subscription](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/createsubscription.md): The following endpoint registers a recurring billing agreement for a customer and returns the subscription in `pending` status. No payment method is collected at this step. The subscription is…
  - [Charge Subscription](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/chargesubscription.md): The following endpoint activates a subscription with its first charge, or retry a payment for past due subscription.
  - [Cancel Subscription](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/cancelsubscription.md): This endpoint permanently cancels a subscription
  - [Fetch Subscriptions](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/listsubscriptions.md): The following endpoint fetch existing subscriptions
  - [Fetch Subscription Charges](https://docs.durianpay.id/reference/listsubscriptioncharges.md): The following endpoint fetch all payments on a single subscription
